title: Random_mob_drops
description: Random dropps from all mobs that drop items that is
body:
# Random drops
This datapack makes mobs drop random items
when they are supposed to drop items that is

for instance, a mob such as a cow can drop leather and meat
in the instance where the cow drops two leather and two meat it would instead drop for example 2 diamonds and two wool, though this is not pre-desided so a cow will drop different items every time

## why
this mod is made to spice up the miecraft experience for players, as a challange or just to mess around.

## playing with friends
I would really recomend playing this with your friends as it allows for very fun interactions
